To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All Advisories, Suspicious Activity Reports, Tips, Intelligence Briefs, Intel Reports, Leads Information or Data, Maps, Bulletins, BOLOs, and/or Joint Bulletins from March 15 2026 to the date this request is processed (inclusive) including the terms "nspm-7" or "nspm7" or "JMC" or "national security presidential memorandum 7" or "antifa" or "anti-surveillance" or "anti surveillance" or "I&A"

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Daniel Boguslaw

communications.subject: Michigan Freedom of Information Act Request: FBI
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

## Time Period

September 1, 2026 through the date this request is processed.

## Records Requested

Please provide copies of the following records created, received, maintained, sent, forwarded, or circulated by the Michigan Intelligence Operations Center that concern National Security Presidential Memorandum 7.

Please include, but do not limit the search to, these record types:

1. Situational Awareness Bulletins (SABs), intelligence products, threat assessments, situation reports, analytical notes, briefing materials, maps, event summaries, or "implications for Michigan" products.
2. Drafts, source packets, notes, emails, email attachments, Teams/Slack/chat messages, memoranda, or calendar invitations discussing, requesting, drafting, reviewing, approving, forwarding, or distributing the records in item 1.
3. Records sent to or received from the Governor's office, Homeland Security Advisor, law-enforcement partners, faith-based organizations, campus police/public-safety agencies, private security/intelligence groups, FBI/JTTF, DHS/I&A, other fusion centers, or the National Network of Fusion Centers.
4. Records identifying planned or monitored protest events, including records based on social-media posts, public webpages, private intelligence reports, or partner tips,

## Exclusions / Narrowing

To reduce burden, I am not seeking generic news clippings, unannotated media articles, daily news digests, newsletters, screenshots, or public webpages standing alone.

For responsive email searches, please search subject lines, body text, and attachment names for the following terms:

NSPM7; NSPM-7; Joint Mission Center; JMC; Anti-tech; Anti-technology; Economic Grievance; anti-capitalist; anti-surveillance; anti-ice; antifa; political violence; left-wing; counter intelligence; I&A

If any portion of a record is exempt, please release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions and identify the statutory basis for each withholding or redaction.

Please provide records electronically in their native format where possible.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Daniel Boguslaw
